shared_elements: stylized rendering of animal body with smoothed volumes
carved animal head with prominent curved beak/muzzle
justification: Both depict an animal in profile with rounded, simplified volumes, but A is a narrative relief frieze of a two-humped pack animal led by robed human attendants with staffs between rosette borders, while B is a free-standing bird of prey with hooked beak, folded ridged wings and clawed feet, with no human figures, no scene and no ornamental banding. The only correspondence is the generic one of 'an animal in profile', which any tradition could produce independently.
